hooks.command: tmp=$(mktemp); cat > "$tmp"; store="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/workstreams/hooks"; for s in "$store"/spec-watch-*.sh "$store"/plan-watch-*.sh; do [ -x "$s" ] || continue; out=$("$s" < "$tmp"); [ -n "$out" ] && printf '%s' "$out" && rm -f "$tmp" && exit 0; done; rm -f "$tmp"; exit 0
